transcript.text: Samsung WW90T534DAW keeps coming up with 4C after a couple of minutes. Drum is dry. Any ideas before I call someone out?

4C typically indicates a water supply issue where little or no water is entering the drum. The most common causes are simply that the tap isn't fully open, the hose is kinked behind the machine, or the inlet filter is blocked with grit. Please switch off and unplug the machine before checking anything. First, ensure the cold water tap is turned fully on and the fill hose isn't squashed against the wall. Then unscrew the hose from the back of the machine to check if the small mesh filter inside the inlet is clean or blocked by debris.
[Helpful to see: image "Where the fill-hose mesh filter is" — A small mesh filter sits inside the fill-hose connector at the tap/valve end and catches grit. Turn the tap off, unscrew the hose and rinse the mesh. Typical layout — your machine may differ.]

Tap was already open, and I turned it fully anticlockwise anyway, no change. Hose isn't kinked. I unscrewed the hose at the machine end and the mesh filter is clogged with grey grit and limescale bits. Should I just clean that and retry?

Yes, please clean that filter thoroughly under running water and reassemble everything before trying again. Once you have done that, turn the tap back on and start a programme to see if it fills normally now or if the 4C code returns. If the error persists after cleaning the filter, the inlet valve itself is likely failing and needs replacing.
Cleaned the filter and put it back, turned the tap on and ran a programme. It fills normally now and the 4C has gone.

That’s excellent news! It sounds like the blocked filter was most likely the culprit. To help prevent this from happening again, I’d suggest checking that inlet mesh every couple of years or if you notice the fill time slowing down. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
